NONE: A2 (the title given to) a person whose job is to care for people who are ill or injured, especially in a hospital

保姆

T: C2 to care for a person or an animal while they are ill
照顧，照料（患病的人或動物）
› to spend a lot of time taking care of something as it grows or develops
養護，培育
